We tested this by mounting a COB LED light with a small reflector. While the stand did not bend, we found that the center of gravity becomes very important at full extension. This is where the integrated hook at the bottom of the center column becomes vital. By hanging a small sandbag or even a camera bag on this hook, the stability increases exponentially. This is a “pro” feature often missing from budget stands.

sources.title: Gear: K&F concept brand review?
sources.snippet: # Gear: K&F concept brand review? Probably a pointless question, but was just wondering if anyone has used any lens filters from K&F? They're pretty cheap and on amazon so I'm hesitant, but I've been meaning to buy a variable ND for my a7iv and was wondering if these guys make half decent stuff? I've seen they have CPL filters and even their own black diffusion, so if anyone can vouch for them I might try them. - I purchased 3 variable ND K&F lens filters from Amazon after checking the ratings and reading all the reviews. I purchased the square filter set and was very pleased with the result, no vinietteing, sharp and accurate colors. - The K&F RF to EOS Adaptor is defective product with lose fitting resulting in the L series lenses losing autofocus every 2 minutes. Tried on Canon EOS R6 Mark II Mirrorless Camera + Canon EF 24-105mm f/4L IS II USM Lens (Total £2800 +£1400 worth new gear) Stay away! - I ordered a tripod and after the weeks it was finally arriving. The day it was to be delivered, the tracking showed it was being returned for an incorrect address. I verified the address on the order and it was correct. Called the post office and K&F had forgotten the Apt number, that was on the order. The order was on the way back to China and there was nothing I could do. - I've used their filters and tripods for years. - I've been using the Nano X-Pro variable ND filters for a few years now. These are definitely the best filters in the price segment (super low budget) that I have found so far. - I have two VND CPLs from them in the Nano X-Pro series and they're really great in terms of build quality and optics. - i bought a couple of "pro mist" filters from them.. The set came with a a couple NDs I think… I never used them, the quality didn’t seems amazing. - No idea about filters, but for what it's worth I recently bought two mount adapters for my old lenses from them and they are very solid and well built.
